races.display_title: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.verdict: ECLAIRAGE is on a good mark if Colin Keane can settle her down and gets the vote to notch a fifth C&D success. Thriving 3-y-os Firewalker and Coincidental Glory seem sure to be in the mix. ECLAIRAGE (IRE) FIREWALKER COINCIDENTAL GLORY (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Firewalker (9/4), Caffu Zafeen (7/2), Eclairage (15/2), Collective Power (9/1), Chicago Call (9/1), Coincidental Glory (11/1), The Highway Rat (11/1), Genesis (12/1), Gerrit's Gem (14/1), Kerdos (25/1), Cuban Grey (25/1), Xerling (40/1), Frescobaldi (40/1)

races.verdict: A useful bumper performer, MOMENTS AWAY wasn't able to build on his hurdling debut effort dropped in trip at Newbury 20 days ago, but he remains capable of better now returned to further. races.display_title: Angel Cybersecurity Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: A trappy handicap and with that in mind a chance is taken on V POWER . A 3-time scorer on the Flat this year, he produced easily his best effort over hurdles when second behind a subsequent winner at Chepstow 2 starts back. He found things tougher under a big weight back there last time but this looks a bit easier and he could represent a spot of value. Cawthorne Cracker arrives in rude health and is feared most, ahead of stablemate Knighton and God of Fire . V POWER CAWTHORNE CRACKER (IRE) KNIGHTON

races.verdict: A case can be made for a few of these but ALWAYS HAPPY shaped well when runner-up at Southwell after an absence last time and can go one better with this first attempt beyond 1m also looking a plus. The consistent Borjina heads the list of dangers off a handy-looking mark, while Arbaawy , Triple Force and Tropical Sands also need factoring in. ALWAYS HAPPY (IRE) BORJINA ARBAAWY
